intro_body: We continuously poll company career pages directly - the same ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, Breezy, Personio, Recruitee) a company posts to before a role ever reaches LinkedIn or a public job board. Every new posting found this way is automatically scored against your resume, and your resume and application questions can be pre-filled without you lifting a finger. Passing jobs show up ready-to-apply on your Dashboard, usually while the listing is still fresh.
stage_idle_hint: Press Run to start discovering and monitoring companies.
radar_title: Continuously re-checking known companies, freshest first
backlog_hours_tooltip: A posting only gets sent to screening if it was posted within this window (uses the actual posting date when the ATS provides one, otherwise the moment we found it). Older postings are still stored and still count toward quantile sorting - they just aren't auto-screened. Applies both to new postings found while running and, on start after being idle, to anything already found but not yet screened. 0 = no age limit, screen everything.
empty_group_cycles_label: Check no-postings companies every N cycles
batch_subtitle: Cheap pre-filter before the full evaluator
batch_hint: New postings are collected into a batch and quick-screened together on a timer, before anything reaches the full evaluator - cheaper and faster than evaluating one by one. Turn it off to send every posting straight to the full evaluator instead.
batch_force_flush_tooltip: If this many postings are queued before the timer runs out, screen them immediately instead of waiting - the timer then resets.
batch_off_note: Batch screening is off - every new posting goes straight to the full evaluator as soon as it's found.
pipeline_subtitle: Where every vacancy is right now
pipe_screen_parallel: {chunk} per request · up to {workers} in parallel
pipe_screen_off: Batch screening is off - postings go straight to evaluation
pipe_post_foot: Runs right after evaluation, only for passed jobs
pipe_post_off: Turned off in the card below
pipe_now_idle: Nothing in progress. Start a run to watch vacancies flow through the pipeline.
pipe_now_waiting: {queue} postings waiting for the next screening
pipe_now_eval: Evaluating {active} ({queued} waiting for a free worker)
pipe_post_parallel: Separate pool · up to {workers} in parallel
pipe_tg_foot: Jobs with a triggered blocker are never sent
danger_zone_hint: Irreversible actions. Your profile, resume and settings are always kept.
wipe_confirm_text: This permanently deletes every job on the Dashboard/Archive, every evaluation, and every discovered company/posting. Your profile, resume and settings are kept. Continue?
step2_hint: A Telegram message as soon as a newly discovered job clears the score threshold below and lands on your Dashboard.
telegram_missing_key_toast: Add a Telegram bot token and chat ID before enabling notifications.
step3_subtitle: Decide what counts as a pass
step3_hint: Every posting - straight from the batch or discovery - gets scored against your resume, blockers and scoring factors. Below the threshold, a job is auto-archived; at or above it, it passes and moves on to tailoring and questions. A job that triggers any blocker is auto-archived regardless of its score.
min_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or above this are marked "passed" and move on to the next steps.
max_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or below this are considered a clear miss and archived automatically.
step4_hint: The switch above decides whether the resume is tailored for every passing job. Everything is always generated; only the checked parts are applied to the resume automatically, the rest stay as suggestions for manual review.
resume_apply_hint: Checked parts are written into the resume on their own. Unchecked parts are still generated and wait for your decision.
resume_apply_exp_titles_tooltip: Role wording in every experience entry.
resume_apply_summary_tooltip: The summary paragraph with the posting's keywords woven in.
resume_apply_skills_tooltip: The skills block with confirmed keywords added.
step_letter_subtitle: Draft a letter for every passing job
step_letter_hint: A cover letter is generated for every passing job from its confirmed keywords. It is independent from resume tailoring and can be turned on separately.
letter_note_placeholder: e.g. Keep the tone direct. Mention that I'm open to relocation.
letter_note_synced: The same note lives in Profile and on the tailoring page - changing it here changes it everywhere.
level_soft_hint: Terminology only - rewording your title, job titles, and reordering/selecting skills you already list. Nothing invented.
level_medium_hint: Light rewrites of your summary and experience bullets to weave in the posting's keywords, grounded only in what's already there.
change_type_title_tooltip: Changes the main headline under your name (e.g. your title/specialization).
change_type_company_name_tooltip: Only reworks how a role's job title is phrased under an experience entry - not the company name, not the main headline.
change_type_skills_tooltip: Reorders and rephrases the skills list, using only skills already present in your resume.
change_type_summary_tooltip: Rewrites the summary paragraph to foreground experience relevant to this posting.
change_type_bullet_tooltip: Targeted edits to experience bullets/paragraphs, weaving in the posting's keywords without inventing anything.
step5_subtitle: Pre-fill answers for every passing job
step5_hint: Every question in the list below is answered automatically for every passing job, using your resume and that specific posting - saved as a draft application you can review and edit afterwards.
base_question_placeholder_example: e.g. Describe a project you're proud of, or Write a cover letter
